command:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

echo "== build the fixture: 3 non-overlapping genes, planted read counts, plus intergenic reads ==" 
cat > gen.awk <<'AWKEOF'
BEGIN{
  srand(7)
  # three non-overlapping single-exon genes + an intergenic region reads must NOT be counted in
  split("geneA geneB geneC", g, " ")
  gs[1]=1000; ge[1]=2000; plant[1]=50
  gs[2]=5000; ge[2]=6000; plant[2]=30
  gs[3]=10000; ge[3]=11000; plant[3]=20
  INTERGENIC=20000; nInter=10
  print "chr1\tsyn\texon\t" gs[1] "\t" ge[1] "\t.\t+\t.\tgene_id \"" g[1] "\"; transcript_id \"t1\";" > "genes.gtf"
  print "chr1\tsyn\texon\t" gs[2] "\t" ge[2] "\t.\t+\t.\tgene_id \"" g[2] "\"; transcript_id \"t2\";" > "genes.gtf"
  print "chr1\tsyn\texon\t" gs[3] "\t" ge[3] "\t.\t+\t.\tgene_id \"" g[3] "\"; transcript_id \"t3\";" > "genes.gtf"
  print "@HD\tVN:1.6\tSO:unsorted" > "reads.sam"
  print "@SQ\tSN:chr1\tLN:50000" > "reads.sam"
  L=100; seq=""; qual=""
  for(i=0;i<L;i++){ seq=seq "A"; qual=qual "I" }
  n=0
  for(k=1;k<=3;k++) for(j=1;j<=plant[k];j++){
    n++
    pos = gs[k] + int(rand()*(ge[k]-gs[k]-L))      # read lies wholly inside the exon
    printf "r%d\t0\tchr1\t%d\t60\t%dM\t*\t0\t0\t%s\t%s\n", n, pos, L, seq, qual > "reads.sam"
    print g[k] > "truth_raw.txt"
  }
  for(j=1;j<=nInter;j++){ n++
    pos = INTERGENIC + j*200
    printf "r%d\t0\tchr1\t%d\t60\t%dM\t*\t0\t0\t%s\t%s\n", n, pos, L, seq, qual > "reads.sam"
  }
  for(k=1;k<=3;k++) print g[k] "\t" plant[k] > "truth.txt"
  printf "genes 3  reads_in_genes %d  intergenic_reads %d  total %d\n", plant[1]+plant[2]+plant[3], nInter, n
}
AWKEOF
awk -f gen.awk

echo "== featureCounts (unstranded is its default) =="
featureCounts -a genes.gtf -o fc.txt -t exon -g gene_id reads.sam > fc.log 2>&1
awk 'NR>2{print $1"\t"$NF}' fc.txt > fc_counts.txt
cat fc_counts.txt
grep -iE "Successfully assigned" fc.log | tail -1
